description: Urban Waste Water Discharge Locations is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Protection Agency. This dataset shows the location of urban waste water discharges. Further information about each licence and their discharge locations can be found on the EPA website - www.epa.ie. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Protection Agency. Its tags are discharge, environment, government, ie, pollutants. It offers 2 resource(s) in JSON, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
